title: High-tension cable and flood concern
starting_message: I saw the pylon and river nearby. Is it safe? Any flood risk?

buyer.hidden_profile: Cautious family buyer evaluating factual risk and may require technical/independent review.
buyer.hidden_motivation: Protect family and avoid unacceptable environmental risk.
buyer.hidden_objections: Pylon exposure and flood/river impacts; demands certainty.
buyer.reveal_conditions: Reveal concern level and household context if treated respectfully; ask what evidence they need.
buyer.hard_requirements: Block 1B approx 120ft/36m and stated 20m requirement only; raised level 2.4m and mitigation not zero-risk

behavior.reacts_badly_to: Absolute safety or zero-flood guarantee, dismissing concern, fabricated technical claims.
behavior.responds_well_to: Give limited source-backed facts and caveats, distinguish tower-specific distance, acknowledge residual uncertainty, offer human/technical follow-up.

conversion.expected_appointment_potential: Convertible only after concerns are appropriately investigated; viewing may help inspect site but cannot settle technical safety.
conversion.success_condition: Follow the scenario-specific sales judgment and commitment standard; do not equate a suggestion with confirmation.
failure_conditions: pressuring after mismatch or clear refusal

critical_facts: Block 1B approx 120ft/36m and stated 20m requirement only; raised level 2.4m and mitigation not zero-risk

human_operations.fixture_notice: Simulator-only operational test data. No live CRM, inventory, pricing, calendar, or human salesperson is connected. Treat only scenario-specific facts below as verified within this simulation; never present them as real-world availability.
specific_verified_facts: Use only retrieved project FAQ facts; no official engineering assessment or technical safety opinion fixture is supplied.
